equity.equity_measurement: Race/ethnicity shares of recipients compared across settings, with an earlier period (16.0% Black) and the case distribution (58.6% Black) as informal referents; NHPI, AI/AN, multiracial and declined collapsed into Other; race unknown for 13.5% at the Health Hub.

notes: Design inferred: no design is named; the report describes recipients of a targeted vaccination program and draws program conclusions, so read as evaluation. Race distributions are compositions of recipients compared across settings (non-SPD groups), so no groupwise entry. Administrative dose records treated as a vaccination registry.
view_issues: The pre-August 9 comparison figure (16.0% Black) comes from a footnoted period (1,106 recipients) not shown in the table; text gives White 54% where the table gives 54.3%.
